collection: TOEFL iBT Listen and Repeat live practice
note: Examiner-facing scripts for two original seven-sentence sets. Independent academic review pending.

questions.subject: Speaking
questions.learningObjective: Repeat a heard sentence accurately and intelligibly in a campus setting.
questions.explanation: The reference answer is the full sentence in its original word order. Mark the spoken response.

markingGuide.description: Wording and order: 2 for exact repetition, 1 for limited changes with most of the sentence retained in order, 0 if little or none of the sentence is reproduced.

Intelligibility: 2 if the words are clear throughout, 1 if some words are difficult to understand, 0 if the response is largely unintelligible or absent. Accept accent variation when the words are intelligible.

questions.deliveryNote: Examiner only. Keep all transcripts out of view. Read the sentence once at a natural pace, then start the response timer. Ask for one spoken repetition.
questions.rubricScale: Original practice points only. No official TOEFL score equivalence.
